I'm sketching out a couple of simple grid layouts with ships placed in distinct rows, planning to keep the shot patterns straightforward to avoid ambiguity.

For the first pair, I'm placing two ships (colors 2 and 3) with two shots that clip and destroy them while leaving a third ship untouched, keeping it easy to follow.

For the second pair, I want to test a shot passing through a gap to hit a ship placed further along the same lane, so I'm starting to lay out a new grid with ships split by gaps in their rows.

I should keep a survivor ship this time, so I'll adjust row1 to leave one cell unhit at column 9. Then for the third pair I want to demonstrate blocking behavior with stacked shots in the same column against a two-row-deep ship layout, working out which cannon hits destroy which ship segments.
